title: 生成AIとマクロ経済－経済モデルで探る影響とシナリオ分析
gist: Promotional page for an Oxford Economics Japanese-language webinar (8 Oct 2026) on generative AI and the macroeconomy; its substance is that OE added an 'AI scenario lever' to its Global Economic Model in July to run consistent scenarios given large uncertainty over the size, speed and distribution of AI's economic impact. Raw language tag says 'en' but the body is mostly Japanese.

insights.claim: Oxford Economics added a new 'AI scenario lever' to its Global Economic Model (GEM) in July 2026, allowing users to set different AI assumptions and run internally consistent macro scenario analysis.
insights.speaker: Oxford Economics
insights.so_what: A major macro-forecasting vendor now offers parameterized AI scenarios, so AI-driven growth/inflation/rate paths will increasingly feed client planning and risk models.
insights.quote: 7月、自社マクロ経済モデルであるGlobal Economic Model（GEM）に新たな「AIシナリオ・レバー」を追加しました
insights.locator: 当社では、7月、自社マクロ経済モデル

insights.claim: Oxford Economics frames AI's macro impact as transmitting from productivity and labor-market effects through to economic growth, inflation, interest rates and financial markets.
insights.speaker: Oxford Economics
insights.so_what: Investors should map AI adoption assumptions explicitly to rates and inflation paths, not just to equity earnings.
insights.quote: AIによる生産性向上や労働市場への影響、経済成長・インフレ・金利・金融市場への波及を把握したい方

insights.claim: Oxford Economics is also introducing a new AI-powered tool to support scenario analysis alongside the GEM AI lever.
insights.speaker: Oxford Economics
insights.so_what: Signals vendor push toward AI-assisted scenario tooling for institutional investors and corporates.
insights.locator: 本ウェビナーでは、AIがマクロ経済・金融市場

insights.claim: Generative AI is already in use worldwide and is beginning to affect corporate activity, productivity and labor markets, per Oxford Economics.
insights.speaker: Oxford Economics
insights.so_what: Supports the view that AI effects are moving from narrative to measurable macro data.
insights.quote: 生成AIはすでに世界中で活用されており、企業活動に大きな影響を与えているほか、生産性や労働市場にもその影響が及び始めています
insights.locator: 生成AIはすでに世界中で活用されており

insights.claim: Oxford Economics stresses large uncertainty about the size and speed of AI's future economic impact and about how its benefits will be distributed, which motivates a multi-scenario rather than point-forecast approach.
insights.speaker: Oxford Economics
insights.so_what: Point forecasts of an AI productivity boom deserve wide error bands; scenario-weighted positioning is more prudent.
insights.quote: AIが今後、経済に与える影響の大きさやスピード、そしてその恩恵の分配については、大きな不確実性が存在します
insights.locator: もっとも、AIが今後、経済に与える影響

insights.claim: Oxford Economics is running a Japanese-language webinar on 8 October 2026 led by Tokyo-based Lead Economist Norihiro Yamaguchi on AI's effects on the macroeconomy, financial markets and labor markets, targeting corporate planners, financial institutions, institutional investors and public bodies.
insights.speaker: Oxford Economics
insights.so_what: Indicates strong Japanese institutional demand for AI macro-scenario analysis to embed in medium-to-long-term plans.

insights.claim: Oxford Economics' related webinar lineup includes 'The AI Export Boom and Its Impact on APAC Real Estate' and a session on an oil and rate spike threatening the world economy, suggesting AI exports and energy/rates shocks are current house themes.
insights.speaker: Oxford Economics
insights.so_what: Hints the house sees an AI export boom spilling into APAC real estate and oil/rate shocks as live risks.
insights.quote: The AI Export Boom and Its Impact on APAC Real Estate
